shared_elements: incised outline framing lines following the edge of the slab
circle/disc motif set centrally on the body
small isolated schematic sign/motif placed in the middle of a panel
justification: Both surfaces treat a vertical slab as a schematic body, with incised contour lines echoing the outline, a belt-like horizontal band across the lower torso, and small isolated motifs (a disc/circle, a cross- or T-shaped sign) set centrally within the enclosed field, which is a fairly specific shared scheme of garment/ornament rendering rather than a generic pattern. The clearest differences are that B carries an explicit sculpted head with facial and hair lines and paired circular ornaments on the chest, whereas A is a flat panel dominated by nested rectilinear frames with no head or paired features, so the specific motif vocabulary only partly overlaps.
